info.name: Start a potentially long-running query against query audits.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of audits to return. Must be in range [1, 100].

params.name: offset
params.description: The number of audits to skip while searching all audits in the time range before returning at most `limit` audits. Must be in range [0, 9007199254740991 (aka `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`)].

params.name: wait
params.description: The number of milliseconds to wait for result before returning. Set this to a negative integer to just return immedately with a `202` and the token. Must be in range [-1, 1000].

params.name: from
params.description: Audits before this timestamp will not be returned. Must be provided as a UTC timestamp in ISO 8601 format `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ`. Defaults to 48 hours before the server received the request. The difference between `from` and `to` may be at most one week.

params.name: to
params.description: Audits after this timestamp will not be returned. Must be provided as a UTC timestamp in ISO 8601 format `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ`. Defaults to when the server received the request. The difference between `from` and `to` may be at most one week.

info.name: Get the results of a potentially long-running query against query audits

params.name: token
params.description: The `token` provided in the `POST` response body. This may be a long string consisting of several thousand characters.
